payloads.description: Baseline authenticated request to /rest/user/whoami
Probe with observed auth tokens to confirm disclosure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains any of ["email","username","lastLoginIp","profileImage"]

test_cases.notes: Establish authenticated session first. Keep requests low-rate.

payloads.description: Baseline request to own basketId=6
Probe nearby numeric id to detect IDOR (non-owner)
Access other observed ids (1,9) to check for authorization bypass

prerequisites.description: Valid authenticated user session required (cookie or bearer)

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code not in baseline.status_code or response.status_code in [403,404] vs 200
response.body contains keys indicative of basket ownership such as ["orderId","paymentId","addressId"]

test_cases.notes: Do not perform destructive actions. Compare responses against baseline for status and body length.

payloads.description: Baseline authenticated request to admin configuration
Probe with observed auth tokens; try non-admin then admin token if available

prerequisites.description: Authenticated session; admin token if available to compare responses

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains any of ["privacyContactEmail","baseUrl","facebookUrl","defaultResponse","config"]

test_cases.notes: If admin token not available, observe differences between user and admin responses. Requires additional observation for admin privilege.

payloads.description: Baseline websocket/socket.io handshake without modifying query params
Probe with manipulated sid/transport to observe session differences

prerequisites.description: Existing authenticated cookie session may be required for socket access

oracle_rules.condition: response.headers["set-cookie"] or response.headers differ from baseline or response contains reflected sid/transport values
response contains socket data not present in baseline or access to other user's socket channels observed

test_cases.notes: Socket endpoints may require observation. Avoid interfering with active sockets.

payloads.description: Baseline search query q=apple
Probe for reflected input (XSS) in search results (benign probe uses script tag but not executed in tests)
Probe for HTML injection reflected in JSON/HTML

prerequisites.description: Optional authenticated session may change results; include if observed

oracle_rules.condition: payload_value in response.body
abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.30

test_cases.notes: Use non-executing payloads. Do not store or trigger malicious payloads. Observe JSON encoding.

payloads.description: Baseline authenticated request to address list
Probe authenticated access to detect address disclosure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains address fields such as ["streetAddress","fullName","zipCode","mobileNum"]

test_cases.notes: Compare against baseline. Avoid creating addresses.

payloads.description: Baseline request to application-version
Probe with sample version query to elicit version info

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains keys like ["version","build","commit","release"]

test_cases.notes: Requires additional observation; try admin vs non-admin tokens.

payloads.description: Baseline valid feedback submission with valid captcha and CSRF token
Probe with invalid captcha to observe rejection response
Probe automated submission patterns to test captcha robustness

prerequisites.description: CSRF token required in form/body; extract from GET form or page
prerequisites.custom_logic: attach token as header or body field as observed

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code in [200,201] and response.body contains success indication while probe baseline with invalid captcha returns 4xx
abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.50

test_cases.notes: Captcha present; automated exploit attempts should be limited. Ensure CSRF token included.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch reviews for productId=6
Probe with high/non-existent id to detect disclosure or differences
Probe for injection/reflection in path parameter (non-destructive)

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains unexpected fields or PII such as ["email","userId"] for non-public products

test_cases.notes: Use non-destructive probes. Observe for PII in responses.

payloads.description: Baseline request to captcha endpoint
Probe with wrong answer to observe rejection response
If correct answer known, probe for success response (use only if answer obtained legitimately)

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code == 200 and subsequent protected action allowed without further challenge
abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.30

test_cases.notes: Do not attempt to brute-force captchas. Only test with known/legitimate answers.

payloads.description: Baseline access to own addressId=7
Probe other address IDs to detect IDOR

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code not equal to baseline.status_code or is 200 when expecting 403/404
response.body contains address fields not belonging to authenticated user

test_cases.notes: Compare responses for status and content. Avoid modifying resources.

payloads.description: Baseline update to own itemId=9 with small quantity
Probe updating another itemId to detect authorization bypass

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code not equal baseline.status_code or response.status_code in [200,403,404] when expected otherwise
response.body contains basket ownership or modification confirmation indicating other user's item modified

test_cases.notes: Non-idempotent — avoid making destructive changes. Use minimal quantity and restore if applicable.

payloads.description: Baseline add to own basket
Probe adding to another basket id to detect authz enforcement

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code in [201] for success vs [401,403] for unauthorized
response.body contains ownership fields or basket identifiers linking to other user

test_cases.notes: Avoid creating persistent unwanted items; cleanup if created.

payloads.description: Baseline authenticated wallet balance request
Probe with auth token to confirm balance disclosure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains fields like ["balance","payments","walletId"]

test_cases.notes: High sensitivity — minimize probing frequency.

payloads.description: Load change-password form to observe CSRF token requirement
Probe access to change-password endpoint to verify CSRF enforcement

prerequisites.description: CSRF token must be extracted from GET response/form and included in subsequent state-changing requests

oracle_rules.condition: ability to perform password change without valid CSRF token results in state change (compare baseline)
responses missing expected CSRF headers or differing set-cookie behavior vs baseline

test_cases.notes: Do not perform actual password changes; only verify presence/requirement of token. Use safe, non-destructive checks.

payloads.description: Baseline access to tracking id observed in traffic
Probe neighboring and random trackIds to detect disclosure

prerequisites.description: If endpoint requires auth, use authenticated session; otherwise public tokens may work

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains order fields like ["email","addressId","orderId","paymentId"]

test_cases.notes: Avoid scraping large ranges. Respect rate limits.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch i18n payloads
Probe for injection via language parameter if present

prerequisites.description: Optional authentication may change returned payloads

oracle_rules.condition: payload_value in response.body
response.body contains unexpected keys/values not present in baseline

test_cases.notes: Use non-executing payloads. Observe JSON encoding and client-side rendering risk.

payloads.description: Baseline 2FA status check for authenticated account
Probe using different account token to detect enumeration differences

prerequisites.description: Authenticated sessions for accounts with and without 2FA to compare responses

oracle_rules.condition: abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.20

test_cases.notes: Compare known 2FA-enabled vs disabled accounts only.

payloads.description: Baseline load of profile page with authenticated cookie
Probe access using different session to detect profile exposure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains user-identifying fields like ["email","username","lastLoginIp","profileImage"]

test_cases.notes: High sensitivity; minimize probes.

payloads.description: Baseline access to deliveryId=1
Probe other delivery ids to detect sensitive configuration exposure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains fields like ["icon","name","status","data"] beyond baseline

test_cases.notes: Non-destructive probes only.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch of itemId=9
Probe other itemIds to detect IDOR exposure

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code not equal baseline.status_code or is 200 when expecting 403/404

test_cases.notes: Compare responses and do not modify resources.

payloads.description: Baseline safe update to own itemId=10
Probe attempting to modify other user's item

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code not equal baseline.status_code or 200 vs 403/404 observed
abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.30

test_cases.notes: Avoid persistent modifications; use minimal changes and restore if needed.

payloads.description: Single legitimate login attempt baseline
Probe failed login to observe status/code/time
Additional safe probes to detect rate limiting/timing anomalies

prerequisites.description: CSRF token required for login form; extract and include

oracle_rules.condition: response.time_ms > baseline.time_ms + 2000
response.status_code in [200,401,429] indicating success, failure or rate-limit

test_cases.notes: Brute-force attempts are rate-limited; respect delay_between_requests to avoid lockouts.

payloads.description: Baseline legitimate data export request
Probe with different format to observe export behavior

oracle_rules.condition: response contains exported user data or file link

test_cases.notes: Export returns sensitive data; limit number of exports and store securely.

payloads.description: Baseline checkout of own basket with valid order details
Probe checkout using other address/payment ids to detect authorization issues

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code in [200] for success vs [401,403] for unauthorized attempts
response.body contains order confirmation details including paymentId or orderId

test_cases.notes: Do not place real orders. Use test payment/delivery ids; avoid generating financial transactions.

payloads.description: Baseline account creation with unique email to observe normal response
Probe duplicate email and weak password responses

prerequisites.description: CSRF token required for registration form

oracle_rules.condition: abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.20
response.status_code in [201,400,409] indicating success or errors

test_cases.notes: Use disposable unique emails to avoid collisions. Respect account creation limits.

payloads.description: Baseline submission of security answer (non-destructive)
Probe different answers to detect response differences indicating correct answer

oracle_rules.condition: abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.20
successful submission returns linkage or user info

test_cases.notes: Do not attempt credential stuffing; use minimal probes.

payloads.description: Baseline card tokenization attempt using test card number
Probe for storage/response containing masked card data

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains card reference or masked number (e.g., '****1111')

test_cases.notes: Use only test card numbers. Do not submit real card data.

payloads.description: Baseline add address to authenticated account
Probe for injection/reflection in address fields

oracle_rules.condition: abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.20
new address appears in subsequent GET /api/Addresss list

test_cases.notes: Use test addresses and remove if created. Avoid polluting production data.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch order history for authenticated account
Probe with auth token to verify orders returned

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains orders array with fields like ["orderId","items","total","paymentId"]

test_cases.notes: Limit frequency of checks.

payloads.description: Baseline request to fetch captcha image
Probe image id enumeration/replay with single id

oracle_rules.condition: image URL predictable allowing enumeration or external callbacks observed
abs(len(response.body)-len(baseline.body))/max(1,len(baseline.body)) > 0.20

test_cases.notes: Do not attempt mass enumeration. Limit probes.

payloads.description: Baseline continue-code usage if available
Probe reflection and possible redirect/use of continueCode

prerequisites.description: Authenticated session observed; use session cookie if required

oracle_rules.condition: payload_value in response.body or in redirect location header
response contains session/state info tied to continueCode

test_cases.notes: Avoid using real continuation tokens. Use synthetic probes.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch of security questions list
Repeat to detect unexpected keys/PII

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains unexpected question metadata or PII

test_cases.notes: Lightweight checks only.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch of recycle/debug data
Probe with auth to observe additional debug data exposure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains debug keys such as ["err","stack","data"]

test_cases.notes: Avoid triggering server errors.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch productId=24
Probe unpublished/high ids for exposure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains unpublished fields or internal flags not present in baseline

test_cases.notes: Limit enumeration breadth.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch public feedback list
Probe search or filters to surface PII in comments

oracle_rules.condition: response.body items contain PII like emails or phone numbers

test_cases.notes: Do not post feedback here for testing.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch delivery methods list
Probe with auth to reveal internal names/configs

prerequisites.description: Authenticated session may reveal more details

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains internal config or debug fields not present in baseline

test_cases.notes: Lightweight enumeration only.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch cardId=7
Probe other cardIds to detect IDOR exposing masked card info

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code differs from baseline or returns 200 exposing masked card info when unauthorized

test_cases.notes: High sensitivity; avoid exposing card data. Use test accounts.

payloads.description: Baseline fetch basket item 9
Probe other item ids for exposure

oracle_rules.condition: response.body contains item details and owner identifiers not belonging to requester

test_cases.notes: Non-destructive enumeration only.

payloads.description: Baseline safe update
Probe unauthorized update to other item

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code not equal baseline.status_code or 200 vs 403/404 observed

test_cases.notes: Avoid making destructive changes. Use minimal non-persistent updates.

payloads.description: Baseline deletion attempt (if permitted) on own item; prefer non-destructive check
Probe deletion of other item ids to detect unauthorized deletion

oracle_rules.condition: response.status_code differs from baseline or is 200 when unauthorized deletion attempted

test_cases.notes: Prefer non-destructive checks; avoid actual deletions where possible.

global_prerequisites.description: Most tests require an authenticated session; obtain session cookie or bearer token via /rest/user/login
CSRF token extraction for endpoints marked token_in_form (e.g., /rest/user/login, /api/Users/, /api/Feedbacks/)

execution_hints.value: Respect delay_between_requests and avoid aggressive enumeration; some endpoints enforce rate limits or account lockout.
Certain socket/io and captcha endpoints require additional traffic capture to fill sample values.
